title_zh: 亞斯納 第 9 章‧豪麻讚（上）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
hâvanîm â ratûm â haomô
upâit zarathushtrem âtrem pairi-ýaozhdatheñtem
gâthåsca srâvayañtem, â-dim peresat
zarathushtrô, kô nare ahî ýim azem vîspahe
anghêush astvatô sraêshtem dâdaresa hvahe
gayehe hvanvatô ameshahe.
segments.en:
At the hour of Havani, Haoma came to Zarathushtra, as he served
the (sacred) Fire, and sanctified (its flame), while he sang aloud
the Gathas. And Zarathushtra asked him: Who art thou, O honorable one! who art
of all the incarnate world the most beautiful in Thine own body of those
whom I have, seen, (thou) glorious [immortal]?
segments.zh: 在哈瓦尼時辰，豪麻來到查拉圖斯特拉面前，當他侍奉（聖）火焰，將其聖化，同時大聲唱誦伽薩之時。查拉圖斯特拉問他：你是誰啊，尊貴者！你是我所見過的整個有形世界中，在你自己的身軀上最美麗的（你）光榮的〔不朽者〕？

segments.orig:
âat mê aêm paityaoxta haomô ashava
dûraoshô, azem ahmi zarathushtra haomô ashava
dûraoshô, â-mãm ýâsanguha
spitama frâ-mãm hunvanguha hvaretêe aoi mãm
staomaine stûidhi ýatha mâ aparacit saoshyañtô
stavãn.
segments.en:
Thereupon gave Haoma answer, the holy one who driveth death
afar: I am, O Zarathushtra Haoma, the holy and driving death afar;
pray to me, O Spitama, prepare me for the taste. Praise me so that
also the other Saoshyants [benefactors] may praise me.
segments.zh: 於是豪麻應答，那位聖者，那位將死亡驅遠者：我是，查拉圖斯特拉啊，豪麻，聖者且將死亡驅遠者；請向我祈禱吧，斯皮塔瑪啊，為了品嚐而準備我。讚美我，好讓其他薩奧希揚特〔恩人們〕也讚美我。

segments.orig:
âat aoxta zarathushtrô, nemô haomâi
(zôt,) kase-thwãm paoiryô haoma mashyô
astvaithyâi hunûta gaêthyâi, kâ
ahmâi ashish erenâvi cit ahmâi jasat âyaptem.
segments.en:
Thereupon spake Zarathushtra: Unto Haoma be the praise. What
man, O Haoma! first prepared thee for the corporeal world? What
award was offered him? what gain did he acquire?
segments.zh: 於是查拉圖斯特拉說：願豪麻受讚美。何人，豪麻啊！首先為有形世界而準備了你？什麼獎賞給予了他？他獲得了什麼利益？

segments.orig:
âat mê aêm paityaoxta haomô ashava
dûraoshô, vîvanghå mãm paoiryô
mashyô astvaithyâi hunûta gaêthyâi,
hâ ahmâi ashish erenâvi tat ahmâi jasat
âyaptem ýat hê puthrô us-zayata ýô
ýimô xshaêtô hvãthwô hvarenanguhastemô
zâtanãm hvare-daresô mashyânãm,
ýat kerenaot ainghe xshathrâdha amarsheñta
pasu vîra anghaoshemne âpa urvaire hvairyãn
hvarethem ajayamnem.
segments.en:
Thereupon did Haoma answer me, he the holy one, and driving
death afar: Vivanghvant was the first of men who prepared me for
the incarnate world. This award was offered him; this gain
did he acquire, that to him was born a son who was Yima, called
the brilliant, (he of the many flocks, the most glorious of those
yet born, the sunlike-one of men), that he made from his authority
both herds and people free from dying, both plants and waters
free from drought, and men could eat inexhaustible food.
segments.zh: 於是豪麻應答我，那位聖者，那位將死亡驅遠者：瓦普英沃姆特是首先為有形世界而準備我的人。這獎賞給予了他；這利益他獲得了，即：一個兒子誕生於他，那是伊瑪，稱為光榮者，（他具有眾多的牲畜，是迄今誕生者中最光榮的，人類中太陽般的者），他從他的權威使得牲畜和人民免於死亡，植物和水源免於乾旱，人類能食用取之不盡的食物。

segments.orig:
ýimahe xshathre aurvahe nôit aotem ångha
nôit garemem nôit zaurva ångha nôit merethyush
nôit araskô daêvô-dâtô, pañca-dasa
fracarôithe pita puthrasca raodhaêshva katarascit
ýavata xshayôit hvãthwô ýimô
vîvanguhatô puthrô.
segments.en:
In the reign of brave Yima was there neither cold
nor heat, there was neither age nor death, nor envy demon-made.
Like teenagers walked the two forth, son and father, in
their stature and their form, so long as Yima, son of Vivanghvant
ruled, he of the many herds!
segments.zh: 在勇敢的伊瑪的統治中既無嚴寒也無酷熱，既無衰老也無死亡，也無惡魔造成的嫉妒。像少年一樣父子二人在他們的身量和形貌中往來，只要光榮者伊瑪、瓦普英沃姆特之子統治，那多畜之者統治著！

segments.orig:
kase-thwãm bityô haoma mashyô astvaithyâi
hunûta gaêthyâi, kâ ahmâi ashish
erenâvi cit ahmâi jasat âyaptem.
segments.en:
Who was the second man, O Haoma! who prepared thee for the
corporeal world? What award was offered him? what gain did
he acquire?
segments.zh: 誰是第二人，豪麻啊！他為有形世界而準備了你？什麼獎賞給予了他？他獲得了什麼利益？

segments.orig:
âat mê aêm paityaoxta haomô ashava
dûraoshô, âthwyô mãm bityô
mashyô astvaithyâi hunûta gaêthyâi,
hâ ahmâi ashish erenâvi tat ahmâi jasat
âyaptem ýat hê puthrô us-zayata vîsô
sûrayå thraêtaonô,
segments.en:
Thereupon gave Haoma answer, he the holy one, and driving
death afar: Athwya was the second who prepared-me for the corporeal
world. This award was given him, this gain did he acquire,
that to him a son was born, Thraetaona of the mighty clan,
segments.zh: 於是豪麻應答，那位聖者，那位將死亡驅遠者：阿圖亞是第二位為有形世界而準備我的人。這獎賞給予了他，這利益他獲得了，即：一個兒子誕生於他，斯拉埃陶納，偉大的氏族者，

segments.orig:
ýô janat azhîm dahâkem thrizafanem
thrikameredhem xshvash-ashîm hazangrâ-ýaoxshtîm
ashaojanghem daêvîm drujem akhem gaêthâvyô
drvañtem ýãm ashaojastemãm drujem
fraca kereñtat angrô mainyush aoi ýãm
astvaitîm gaêthãm mahrkâi ashahe gaêthanãm.
segments.en:
Who smote Azhi Dahaka, three-jawed and triple-headed,
six-eyed, with thousand perceptions, and of mighty strength, a lie-demon
[druj] of the Daevas, evil for our settlements, and wicked, whom the
evil spirit Angra Mainyu made as the most mighty Druj [against
the corporeal world], and for the murder of (our) settlements,
and to slay the (homes) of Asha!
segments.zh: 他擊殺了阿日‧達哈卡，三顎和三頭，六眼、具千種感知，具強大力量的謊言德魯格、達埃瓦族者，於我們的定居處邪惡而兇殘，惡靈安格拉‧曼紐造作為最強大的德魯格〔對抗有形世界〕，並為了殺害（我們的）定居處，並殺害（阿沙的）家園！

segments.orig:
kase-thwãm thrityô haoma mashyô astvaithyâi
hunûta gaêthyâi, kâ ahmâi ashish
erenâvi cit ahmâi jasat âyaptem.
segments.en:
Who was the third man, O Haoma! who prepared thee for the
corporeal world? What award was given him? what gain did
he acquire?
segments.zh: 「啊，豪麻！第三個為你準備肉身世界的人，是誰？給了他什麼報償？他得到了什麼利益？」

segments.orig:
âat mê aêm paityaoxta haomô ashava
dûraoshô, thritô sâmanãm sevishtô
thrityô mãm mashyô astvaithyâi hunûta
gaêthyâi, hâ ahmâi ashish erenâvi
tat ahmâi jasat âyaptem ýat hê puthra
us-zayôithe urvâxshayô keresâspasca, tkaêshô
anyô dâtô-râzô âat anyô
uparô-kairyô ýava gaêsush gadhavarô,
segments.en:
Thereupon gave Haoma answer, the holy one, and driving death
afar: Thrita, [the most helpful of the Samids], was the third man
who prepared me for the corporeal world. This award was
given him, this gain did he acquire, that to him two son were
born, Urvakhshaya and Keresaspa, the one a judge confirming order,
the other a youth of great ascendant, curly-haired, bludgeon-bearing.
segments.zh: 於是，持阿沙的聖者豪麻，驅散死亡於遠方，答道：「斯里塔，〔薩瑪家族中最樂於助人的一位〕，是第三個為我準備肉身世界的人。給了他這報償，他得到了這利益：他得了兩個兒子，烏爾瓦赫沙亞和凱雷薩斯帕。一個是維護秩序的法官，另一個是前程遠大的青年，捲髮，手持大棒。」

segments.orig:
ýô janat azhîm srvarem ýim aspô-garem
nere-garem ýim vîshavañtem zairitem ýim
upairi vîsh araodhat ârshtyô-bareza zairitem,
ýim upairi keresâspô ayangha pitûm pacata
â rapithwinem zrvânem, tafsatca hô mairyô
hvîsatca, frãsh ayanghô frasparat ýaeshyañtîm
âpem parånghât, parãsh tarshtô
apatacat naire-manå keresâspô.
segments.en:
He who smote the horny dragon swallowing men, and swallowing
horses, poisonous, and green of color over which, as thick as
thumbs are, greenish poison flowed aside, on whose back once Keresaspa
cooked his meat in iron caldron at the noonday meal; and the deadly,
scorched, upstarted, and springing off, dashed out the water as
it boiled. Headlong fled affrighted manly-minded Keresaspa.
segments.zh: 他擊殺了那長角的巨龍，那吞噬馬匹、吞噬人畜的，有毒的，綠色的。在它身上，有拇指般粗的綠色毒液流淌。凱雷薩斯帕曾在它背上，於正午時分，用鐵鍋煮肉。那致命的、灼熱的巨龍驚起，彈跳開來，濺出了沸騰的水。膽氣過人的凱雷薩斯帕驚恐地奔逃。

segments.orig:
kase-thwãm tûiryô haoma mashyô astvaithyâi
hunûta gaêthyâi, kâ ahmâi ashish
erenâvi cit ahmâi jasat âyaptem.
segments.en:
Who was the fourth man who prepared thee, O Haoma! for the
corporeal world? What blessedness was given him? what gain did
he acquire?
segments.zh: 「啊，豪麻！第四個為你準備肉身世界的人，是誰？給了他什麼福分？他得到了什麼利益？」

segments.orig:
âat mê aêm paityaoxta haomô ashava
dûraoshô, pourushaspô mãm tûiryô
mashyô astvaithyâi hunûta gaêthyâi,
hâ ahmâi ashish erenâvi tat ahmâi jasat
âyaptem ýat hê tûm us-zayangha tûm
erezvô zarathushtra nmânahe pourushaspahe vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô.
segments.en:
Thereupon gave Haoma answer, he the holy, and driving death
afar: Pourushaspa was the fourth man who prepared me for the corporeal
world. This blessedness was given him, this gain did he acquire,
that thou, O Zarathushtra! wast born to him, the just, in Pourushaspa's
house, the Daeva's foe, the friend of Mazda's lore, (14) famed
in Airyana Vaejah; and thou, O Zarathushtra! didst recite the
first the Ahuna-vairya, four times intoning it, and with verses
kept apart [(Pazand) each time with louder and still louder voice].
segments.zh:
於是豪麻作答，聖者啊，驅死遠離：
普魯沙斯帕是第四個為我備製肉體
世界的人。這福祉被賜予他，這利益他獲得，
就是你，查拉圖斯特拉啊！生於他，正義者，於普魯沙斯帕的
家中，達埃瓦的敵人，馬茲達之道的友人，（14）名聞
於艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈；而你，查拉圖斯特拉啊！誦唱了
首先阿胡納‧瓦伊里亞，誦唸四次，並加以頌詞
相隔開來〔（帕贊德）每次以更大聲、愈益更大的聲調〕。

segments.orig:
srûtô airyene vaêjahe tûm paoiryô
zarathushtra ahunem vairîm frasrâvayô vîberethwañtem
âxtûirîm aparem xraozhdyehya frasrûiti.

tûm zemargûrô âkerenavô vîspe
daêva zarathushtra ýôi para ahmât vîrô-raodha
apatayen paiti âya-zemâ, ýô aojishtô
ýô tañcishtô ýô thwaxshishtô
ýô âsishtô ýô as verethrajãstemô
abavat mainivå dâmãn!
segments.en:
And thou didst cause, O Zarathushtra! all the demon-gods to
vanish in the ground who aforetime flew about this earth in human
shape (and power. This hast thou done), thou who hast been the
strongest, and the staunchest, the most active, and the swiftest,
and (in every deed) the most victorious in the two spirits' world.
segments.zh: 「而你，查拉圖斯特拉啊！你使所有達埃瓦神都遁入地下，他們從前曾以人形飛翔於此大地之上。（你成就了此事，）你一直是兩位靈體世界中最強壯、最堅定、最活躍、最迅捷，且（在一切作為中）最勝利的。」

segments.orig:
âat aoxta zarathushtrô, nemô haomâi
vanghush haomô hudhâtô haomô arshdâtô
vanghush dâtô baêshazyô hukerefsh hvaresh
verethrajå zairi-gaonô nãmyãsush ýatha
hvareñte vahishtô urunaêca pâthmainyôtemô.
segments.en:
Thereupon spake Zarathushtra: Praise to Haoma. Good is Haoma,
and the well-endowed, exact and righteous in its nature, and good
inherently, and healing, beautiful of form, and good in deed,
and most successful in its working, golden-hued, with bending
sprouts. As it is the best for drinking, so (through its sacred
stimulus) is it the most nutritious for the soul.
segments.zh: 於是查拉圖斯特拉說：「讚美豪麻。豪麻是善的，是善賜的，是精確而正直的，本性良善，且能醫治，形貌美好，行為良善，功效最為成功，色澤金黃，枝芽彎垂。它既是飲用最佳之物，同樣地，（透過其神聖的激勵）對靈魂也最具滋養。」

segments.orig:
nî-tê zâire madhem mruyê nî
amem nî verethrakhnem nî dasvare nî baêshazem
nî fradathem nî varedathem nî aojô vîspô-tanûm
nî mastîm vîspô-paêsanghem, nî
tat ýatha gaêthâhva vasô-xshathrô
fracarâne tbaêshô taurvå drujem vanô,
segments.en:
I make my claim on thee, O yellow one! for inspiration. I
make my claim on thee for strength; I make my claim on thee for
victory; I make my claim on thee for health and healing (when
healing is my need); I make my claim on thee for progress and
increased prosperity, and vigor of the entire frame, and for understanding,
of each adorning kind, and for this, that I may have free course
among our settlements, having power where I will, overwhelming
angry malice, and a conqueror of lies.
segments.zh: 「我向你，金黃色的豪麻啊！祈求靈感。我向你祈求力量；我向你祈求勝利；我向你祈求健康與醫治（當我需要醫治時）；我向你祈求進步與繁榮增長，以及全身的活力，並祈求各種悅人的理解力，也祈求這一切：使我在我們的居所之間能自由通行，隨心所欲地擁有權力，壓倒憤怒的惡意，並征服謊言。」

segments.orig:
nî tat ýatha taurvayeni vîspanãm
tbishvatãm tbaêshå daêvanãm mashyânãmca
ýâthwãm pairikanãmca sâthrãm
kaoyãm karafnãmca mairyanãmca bizañgranãm
ashemaokhanãmca bizañgranãm vehrkanãmca
cathware-zañgranãm haênyåsca perethu-ainikayå
davãithyå patãithyå!
segments.en:
Yea, I make my claim on thee that I may overwhelm the angry
hate of haters, of the Daevas and of mortals, of the sorcerers
and sirens, of the tyrants, and the Kavis, of the Karpans, murderous
bipeds, of the sanctity-destroyers, the profane apostate bipeds,
of the wolves four-footed monsters, of the invading host, wide-fronted,
which with stratagems advance.
segments.zh: 「是的，我向你祈求，使我能壓倒一切仇恨者的憤怒敵意，無論是達埃瓦或凡人的，巫師或女妖的，暴君與卡維的，卡爾潘的，兇殘的雙足者，毀壞神聖者的，褻瀆的叛教雙足者，四足 monstrous 的狼群，以及陣容廣闊、以詭計進犯的入侵大軍。」

segments.orig:
imem thwãm paoirîm ýânem haoma jaidhyemi
dûraosha, vahishtem ahûm ashaonãm raocanghem
vîspô-hvâthrem, imem thwãm bitîm
ýânem haoma jaidhyemi dûraosha, drvatâtem
ainghåse-tanvô, imem thwãm thritîm ýânem
haoma jaidhyemi dûraosha, darekhô-jîtîm
ushtânahe.
segments.en:
This first blessing I beseech of thee, O Haoma, thou that
drivest death afar! I beseech of thee for (heaven), the best life
of the saints, the radiant, all-glorious.
This second blessing I beseech of thee, O Haoma, thou that drivest
death afar! this body's health (before that blest life is attained).
This third blessing I beseech of thee, O Haoma, thou that drivest
death afar! the long vitality of life.
segments.zh:
我向你祈求這第一種福分，驅逐死亡的豪麻啊！我向你祈求（天堂），聖賢們最美好的生命，那光輝燦爛、全備榮耀的。
我向你祈求這第二種福分，驅逐死亡的豪麻啊！此身之健康（在達成那有福的生命之前）。
我向你祈求這第三種福分，驅逐死亡的豪麻啊！生命之長久活力。

segments.orig:
imem thwãm tûirîm ýânem haoma
jaidhyemi dûraosha ýatha aêshô amavå
thrãfedhô fraxshtâne zemâ paiti tbaêshô
taurvå drujem vanô, imem thwãm puxdhem ýânem
haoma jaidhyemi dûraosha, ýatha verethrajå
vanat-peshanô fraxshtâne zemâ paiti tbaêshô
taurvå drujem vanô.
segments.en:
This fourth blessing I beseech of thee, O Haoma, thou that
drivest death afar! that I may stand forth on this earth with
desires gained, and powerful, receiving satisfaction, overwhelming
the assaults of hate, and conquering the lie.
This fifth blessing, O Haoma, I beseech of thee, thou that drivest
death afar! that I may stand victorious on earth, conquering in
battles, overwhelming the assaults of hate, and conquering the
lie.
segments.zh:
我向你祈求這第四種福分，驅逐死亡的豪麻啊！使我得以立足於此大地上，願望達成，強而有力，心滿意足，擊退仇恨的攻擊，並征服謊言。
我向你祈求這第五種福分，驅逐死亡的豪麻啊！使我得以勝利地立足於大地上，在戰鬥中克敵制勝，擊退仇恨的攻擊，並征服謊言。

segments.orig:
imem thwãm xshtûm ýânem haoma jaidhyemi
dûraosha, paurva tâyûm paurva gadhem paurva
vehrkem bûidhyôimaidhe, mâ-cish paurvô
bûidhyaêta nô vîspe paurva bûidhyôimaidhe!
segments.en:
This sixth blessing I ask of thee, O Haoma, thou that drivest
death afar! that we may get good warning of the thief, good warning
of the murderer, see first the bludgeon-bearer, get first sight
of the wolf. May no one whichsoever get first the sight of us.
In the strife with each may we be they who get the first alarm!
segments.zh: 我向你祈求這第六種福分，驅逐死亡的豪麻啊！使我們能及早警覺盜賊，及早警覺兇手，先看見持棍者，先發現野狼。願沒有任何一人能先看見我們。在與他們的爭鬥中，願我們是首先警覺的一方！

segments.orig:
haomô aêibish ýôi aurvañtô
hita taxsheñti arenâum zâvare aojåsca
baxshaiti, haomô âzîzanâitibish dadhâiti
xshaêtô-puthrîm uta ashava-frazaiñtîm,
haomô taêcit ýôi katayô naskô-frasånghô
ångheñte spânô mastîmca baxshaiti.
segments.en:
Haoma grants to racers who would run a course with span both
speed and bottom (in their horses). Haoma grants to women come
to bed with child a brilliant offspring and a righteous line.
Haoma grants to those (how many!) who have long sat searching
books, more knowledge and more wisdom.
segments.zh: 豪麻賜予那些馳騁賽場的騎手，以（他們的）馬匹，速度與耐力。豪麻賜予臨產的婦女，以傑出的後嗣與正直的世系。豪麻賜予那些（何其眾多！）長久坐而研讀經書之人，以更多的知識與更多的智慧。

segments.orig:
haomô tåscit ýå kainînô
ånghaire darekhem akhrvô haithîm râdhemca
baxshaiti moshu jaidhyamnô huxratush.
segments.en:
Haoma grants to those long maidens, who sit at home unwed,
good husbands, and that as soon as asked, he Haoma, the well-minded.
segments.zh: 豪麻賜予那些長久待字閨中、坐於家中的少女，以良善的丈夫，且一經祈求便速速賜予，他，明智的豪麻。

segments.orig:
haomô temcit ýim keresânîm apa-xshathrem
nishâdhayat ýô raosta xshathrô-kâmya
ýô davata, nôit mê apãm âthrava
aiwishtish vereidhyê dainghava carât, hô vîspe
vereidhinãm vanât nî vîspe vereidhinãm
janât!
segments.en:
Haoma lowered Keresani, dethroned him from his throne, for
he grew so fond of power, that he treacherously said: No priest
behind (and watching) shall walk the lands for me, as a counselor
to prosper them, he would rob everything of progress, he would
crush the growth of all!
segments.zh: 豪麻使那凱雷薩尼失勢，將他從王座上推翻，因他如此貪戀權力，竟奸詐地說道：沒有祭司（在後監督）應為我行走於諸邦，作為顧問以使其繁榮，他會奪走一切進展，他會摧毀一切生長！

segments.orig:
ushta-tê ýô hvâ aojangha vasô-xshathrô
ahi haoma, ushta-tê apivatahe pourvacãm erezhuxdhanãm,
ushta-tê nôit pairi-frâsa erezhuxdhem peresahe
vâcim.
segments.en:
Hail to thee, O Haoma, who hast power as thou wilt, and by
thine inborn strength! Hail to thee, thou art well-versed in many
sayings, and true and holy words. Hail to thee for thou dost ask
no wily questions, but questionest direct.
segments.zh: 讚美你，豪麻啊！你擁有如你所願的權能，並憑藉你與生俱來的力量！讚美你，你精通許多言辭，以及真實而神聖的言語。讚美你，因你不問狡詐的問題，而是直接發問。

segments.orig:
frâ-tê mazdå barat paurvanîm aiwyånghanem
stehrpaêsanghem mainyutâshtem vanguhîm daênãm
mâzdayasnîm, âat ainghe ahi aiwyâstô
barshnush paiti gairinãm drâjanghe aiwidhâitîshca
gravasca mãthrahe!
segments.en:
Forth hath Mazda borne to thee, the star-bespangled girdle,
the spirit-made, the ancient one, the Mazdayasnian Faith.
So with this thou art begirt on the summits of the mountains,
for the spreading of the precepts, and the headings of the Mathra,
(and to help the Mathra's teacher),
segments.zh:
馬茲達已為你繫上那綴滿星辰的腰帶，那由靈體所造、亙古長存者，即馬茲達教之信仰。
因此，你以此腰帶束身，立於群山之巔，為傳播教誡，為誦讀瑪斯拉（之要義），（並助瑪斯拉之導師）。

segments.orig:
haoma nmânô-paite vîspaite zañtupaite
dainghupaite spanangha vaêdhyâ paite, amâica
thwâ verethrakhnâica mâvôya upa-mruyê
tanuyê thrimâica ýat pouru-baoxshnahe.
segments.en:
O Haoma, thou house-lord, and thou clan-lord, thou tribe-lord,
and chieftain of the land, and thou successful learned teacher,
for aggressive strength I speak to thee, for that which smites
with victory, and for my body's saving, and for manifold delight!
segments.zh: 啊，豪麻神，你是家宅之主，又是部族之主，你是宗族之主，又是國土之領袖，你是成功的飽學導師。為了攻擊的力量，我向你訴說；為了那以勝利擊打的力量，為了我的身體得救，並為了眾多的歡樂，我向你訴說！

segments.orig:
vî-nô tbishvatãm tbaêshêbîsh
vî manô bara grameñtãm, ýô
cishca ahmi nmâne ýô ainghe vîsi ýô
ahmi zañtvô ýô ainghe dainghvô
aênanghå asti mashyô geurvaya-hê pâdhave
zâvare pairi-shê ushi verenûidhi skeñdem
shê manô kerenûidhi.
segments.en:
Bear off from us the torment and the malice of the hateful.
Divert the angry foe's intent!
What man soever in this house is violent and wicked, what man
soever in this village, or this tribe, or province, seize thou
away the fleetness from his feet; throw thou a veil of darkness
o'er his mind; make thou his intellect (at once) a wreck!
segments.zh: 求你從我們身上帶走可憎者的折磨與惡意。求你轉移憤怒敵人的意圖！無論這家宅中有何人暴戾邪惡，無論這村莊、這宗族或這省邦中有何人如此，求你奪去他腳上的敏捷；求你將黑暗的帷幕拋上他的心靈；求你使他的才智（當即）毀滅！

segments.orig:
mâ zbarathaêibya fratuyå mâ gavaêibya
aiwi-tûtuyå mâ zãm vaênôit
ashibya mâ gãm vaênôit ashibya ýô
aênanghaiti nô manô ýô aênanghaiti
nô kehrpem!
segments.en:
Let not the man who harms us, mind or body, have power to
go forth on both his legs, or hold with both his hands, or see
with both his eyes, not the land (beneath his feet), or the herd
before his face.
segments.zh: 願那傷害我們心靈或身體的人，無力以雙足前行，無力以雙手把握，無力以雙眼觀看；無論是腳下的大地，或是眼前的家畜，都不得見。

segments.orig:
paiti azhôish zairitahe simahe vîshô-vaêpahe
kehrpem nâshemnâi ashaone haoma zâire vadare
jaidhi, paiti gadhahe vîvarezdavatô xrvîshyatô
zazarânô kehrpem nâshemnâi ashaone haoma
zâire vadare jaidhi.
segments.en:
At the aroused and fearful Dragon, green, and belching forth
his poison, for the righteous saint that perishes, yellow Haoma,
hurl thy mace!
At the (murderous) bludgeon-bearer, committing deeds unheard of,
blood-thirsty, (drunk) with fury, yellow Haoma, hurl thy mace!
segments.zh: 對著那被激怒的、可怖的巨龍，牠身泛黃綠，噴吐毒液——為了那瀕臨毀滅的義人，黃色的豪麻神啊，投出你的棍棒！對著那（殺人的）狼牙棒持者，他行徑前所未聞，嗜血成性，（沉醉於）狂怒之中——為了那瀕臨毀滅的義人，黃色的豪麻神啊，投出你的棍棒！

segments.orig:
paiti mashyehe drvatô sâstarsh aiwi-vôizhdayañtahe
kameredhem kehrpem nâshemnâi ashaone haoma zâire
vadare jaidhi, paiti ashemaokhahe anashaonô ahûm-mereñcô
ainghå daênayå mãs vaca dathânahe
nôit shyaothnâish apayañtahe kehrpem nâshemnâi
ashaone haoma zâire vadare jaidhi.
segments.en:
Against the wicked human tyrant, hurling weapons at the head,
for the righteous saint that perishes, yellow Haoma, hurl thy
mace!
Against the righteousness-disturber, the unholy life-destroyer,
thoughts and words of our religion well-delivering, yet in actions
never reaching, for the righteous saint that perishes, yellow
Haoma, hurl thy mace!
segments.zh: 對著那邪惡的凡人暴君，他朝人頭部投擲武器——為了那瀕臨毀滅的義人，黃色的豪麻神啊，投出你的棍棒！對著那擾亂阿沙者，那不持阿沙的毀滅生命者，他對我們宗教的思想與言語傳遞得宜，行為上卻從未達成——為了那瀕臨毀滅的義人，黃色的豪麻神啊，投出你的棍棒！

segments.orig:
paiti jahikayâi ýâtumaityâi maodhanô-
kairyâi upashtâ-bairyâi ýenghe frafravaiti
manô ýatha awrem vâtô-shûtem kehrpem
nâshemnâi ashaone haoma zâire vadare jaidhi,
ýat hê kehrpem nâshemnâi ashaone haoma
zâire vadare jaidhi!!
segments.en:
Against the body of the harlot, with her magic minds o'erthrowing
with (intoxicating) pleasures, to the lusts her person offering,
whose mind as vapor wavers as it flies before the wind, for the
righteous saint that perishes, yellow Haoma, hurl thy mace!
<H2 id=y10
segments.zh: 對著那妓女的身體，她以迷幻的享樂顛覆人心，將自身獻於淫慾，她的心靈如煙霧般在風前飄搖不定——為了那瀕臨毀滅的義人，黃色的豪麻神啊，投出你的棍棒！
